result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers say the designer is only partly right and recommend a simplified mark plus a sew-out sample. A ties the favicon and the embroidery failures to the same root cause, and it lists more of the causes: thin lines, small text, gaps that close up, low contrast and gradients. It also keeps the scope small and explicit with 'two small derivative files and one test sample.' B is solid but omits closing gaps and low contrast as causes, and its favicon deliverables are a little heavier than a small firm needs. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B covers more of the causes: thin strokes, small text, gaps that close up, and low-contrast colors. It ties each one to both the tab icon and the polo, and it says what to remove from the simplified mark. A is accurate but less complete. It skips the small gaps and low-contrast colors, and it lays out its few versions less clearly than B's 'two small derivative files and one test sample.'
